candidates.reason: This is the file the pull request edits and the only place the flaky assertion lives. `test_slow_pipeline` submits ITEM_A and ITEM_B through a pipeline that awaits scrapy.utils.asyncio.sleep(0.1) for every item, so completion order follows event-loop timer scheduling instead of submission order, and the helper `_test_spider` compares `actual_items == expected_items` strictly. The fix adds an `ordered` flag (default True) to `_test_spider` and calls it with `ordered=False` from `test_slow_pipeline`, so this file holds both the reproducing test and the unchanged single-item tests (`test_start_urls`, `test_start`, `test_start_subclass`, `test_asyncio_delayed`, `test_twisted_delayed`) that exercise the ordered default and guard against regressions from the signature change.
